text: At 65 minutes, Kingsmoor FC implemented a pressing trigger by increasing their PPDA from 8.5 to 7.6 and raising their defensive line height from 0.5 to 0.62, aiming to press higher and force turnovers earlier in their 4-4-2 setup. They simultaneously altered their attacking mechanism toward increased directness (0.5 to 0.65), moving away from their typical wide crossing play to expedite progression through more vertical, direct passing lanes. This tactical adjustment created an overload in forward transitions but also led to doubled high turnovers in dangerous areas, which coincided with a possession drop from 57.6% to 51.6% and reduced their xG from 0.05 to 0. Westport Albion’s rest-defense remained effective, evidenced by a slight decrease in their xG (0.74 to 0.64) despite Kingsmoor’s intensified pressing effort, demonstrating resilience against the increased pressure [#1187].
